scope: 36 observed original 2021 Cape Crozier solitary breeding sites, excluding solo27, with source-specific exact GPS join
raw_outcome: at least one directly confirmed chick in creche; non-confirmation is NOT confirmed death
fixed_descriptive_checks: early visitor-days per site by initial exposure group
original nest rocksize >=15cm vs <15cm strata, source raw per-stratum count not causal adjusted effect
only original field area codes with both early-neighbor and no-neighbor sites, exclude unique-only codes from a separate descriptive overlap table without changing main 36-site denominator
exclude only sites with an explicit source GONE by December1, report original 36-site comparison first
stage chronology of earliest egg and earliest positive neighbor remains 5 earlier,2 same,1 later,1 no first egg before cutoff

calculate minimum number of additional unconfirmed crèche events among the 27 non-neighbor nests needed for that observed fraction to reach >= 5/9, holding directly confirmed positive count and 36-site denominator fixed
do not manufacture p-values, confidence intervals, intervention, predation or reproductive recruitment observations
scientific_stop: not a random neighbor arrival process
no independent predator or true chick survival tracking beyond original coded source
observed negative confirmed is not proof of biological failure
baseline area/rock strata may have observation-protocol and parental quality confounders
site area codes are geographic coarse labels not randomized clusters and within-area subsamples are tiny
no model tuning or new outcome opening after seeing grouped results
